lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 distinct white vertical lines of varying intensity; spacing is non-uniform, with wider gaps between the third and fourth lines relative to the more compressed posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and third anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 2-3 high-contrast spots is visible on the lower haunch area near the junction of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit an initial lateral flare from the base at approximately 35 degrees, transitioning into a vertical lyrate curve with tips converging slightly inward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The apical span between the tips is approximately 3 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tipping represents approximately 10% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/malar region; prominent white-tipped dorsal mane extending along the spine.
